description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Set when a class runs; future classes are generated for the booking horizon. Use it for a class (sessions-mode offering) whose weekly timetable changes; the timetable sent replaces the class's old weekly pattern, so send all of it; classes already generated are kept. Not for appointments or rentals (owner_set_schedule sets their hours).

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

offering_id.description: The class: offerings[].offering_id of a sessions-mode offering

schedule.description: The weekly timetable: each entry is a day pattern and a start time

capacity_online.description: Seats that can be booked online
